subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this PR merge persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs into the existing SecretRef resolution path before the optional-TTS startup policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 is resolved?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but adding new credential targets changes which persona TTS configs are resolved or fail through the current runtime SecretRef path; automation should not decide that sequencing alone.

options.title: Require proof, then land
options.body: After redacted live persona SecretRef proof, merge this fix with the current SecretRef semantics and track optional missing-key degradation separately.

options.title: Sequence after optional TTS handling
options.body: Hold this PR until the optional TTS SecretRef startup behavior lands or is explicitly rejected, reducing upgrade ambiguity for missing persona keys.

options.title: Keep persona SecretRefs unsupported
options.body: Do not merge this target expansion if maintainers want persona provider credentials excluded from the core SecretRef surface for now.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then land
recommendation.body: After redacted live persona SecretRef proof, merge this fix with the current SecretRef semantics and track optional missing-key degradation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the SecretRef runtime assignment and target registry semantics introduced in PR 29580.
